code: ## Check R version if (getRversion() < "4.6.0") stop("This workshop needs R 4.6.0 or later (you have ", getRversion(), "). Please update R and re-run.")  ## install BiocManager if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))   install.packages("BiocManager")  options(repos = BiocManager::repositories(version="3.23"))  ## install remotes install.packages(c('remotes','usethis'))  ## install workshop package (takes care of dependencies) remotes::install_github("michaelplynch/foundations-of-single-cell-data-science@1.0.0",dependencies=TRUE, upgrade='always')  ## Course notebooks (same release); answer the prompts, notebooks are in vignettes/ usethis::use_course(   "https://github.com/michaelplynch/foundations-of-single-cell-data-science/archive/refs/tags/1.0.0.zip",   destdir = "~" )  ## Pre-download the dataset and check everything loads sce <- TENxPBMCData::TENxPBMCData("pbmc4k") sce <- muscData::Kang18_8vs8() pkgs <- c("SingleCellExperiment", "scater", "scrapper", "dittoSeq", "BiocStyle","UCell","mclust") invisible(lapply(pkgs, library, character.only = TRUE)) BiocManager::valid() message("Setup complete - see you at the workshop!")
